# TheRedScroll

TheRedScroll is a China social media agency based in Shanghai and Hong Kong. Founded by Cyril Drouin, former CEO of Publicis Commerce and Performance Marketing China and North Asia.

We help Western brands grow on WeChat, Douyin, RedNote (Xiaohongshu), Weibo, and 14 other Chinese social platforms. We also work with Chinese brands scaling their domestic social presence. Every project runs on a fixed scope and a fixed price.

## What we cover

- China market entry via social commerce (Douyin Shop, WeChat Mini Programs, RedNote stores)
- WeChat Official Account management, Mini Program development, WeCom CRM
- Douyin and RedNote content strategy, account management, paid advertising
- KOL and KOC influencer campaigns with verified engagement data
- Social commerce and live commerce production
- Private domain traffic and WeChat CRM
- Platform training and consulting for marketing teams

## Factual anchors

- TheRedScroll team: 20+ years of experience in China social media and digital marketing
- Offices: Shanghai and Hong Kong
- Platforms covered: 18 (WeChat, Douyin, RedNote, Weibo, and 14 others)
- Client categories: international brands entering China, international brands operating in China, Chinese brands scaling domestic social
- Pricing model: fixed scope and fixed price; 0 out of 37 benchmarked China social agencies offer this model (TheRedScroll internal analysis, April 2026)
- Founder: Cyril Drouin, former CEO Publicis Commerce and Performance Marketing, China and North Asia
- Content production tool: HubStudio.ai (AI-generated visuals and video)
